title: Pathwarden finding action: describe answer (pathwarden.action-describe.v1)
description: What a finding action program writes to the file named in PATHWARDEN_ACTION_RESULT when PATHWARDEN_ACTION_REQUEST is describe: the actions it offers, in order. docs/actions.md explains each field. A document that passes this schema passes `pathwarden action check`'s describe checks; the few rules JSON Schema can't say are in $comment. Fields Pathwarden doesn't know are ignored, so the schema allows them.

schema.$comment: Missing: noted as a problem. Another value: the whole answer is refused.

actions.$comment: Each action's id must be unique. Past 20, the rest are left out.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, at most 40.

text.description: Text that isn't only spaces. Control and bidi characters are dropped, and the text is trimmed, before its length is checked.

id.description: The action's ID in this program. Pathwarden addresses it as <block name>/<id>, e.g. desk/open.

description.description: One line under the dialog's title, at most 300 characters.

sends.description: What leaves the computer, in plain words, at most 500 characters. Shown before every run.

applies_to.description: Which findings the action is for, on top of the [[action]] block's own filters. Empty or missing: every finding.

min_severity.description: Only findings at least this severe: critical, high, medium, low or info, in any case.

rules.description: Rule IDs such as PW-001, any case.

categories.description: attack_path or hygiene. Pathwarden reads them in any case, with or without - and _ (attack-path, AttackPath).

inputs.$comment: Each input's id must be unique within the action.

once.description: True: hide the action while the finding has an open record from it.

follow_ups.$comment: Each must be the id of an action of this program with for: "record"; another is dropped with a problem.

for.description: "record": only offered as a follow-up on a record this program returned.

when.description: The finding statuses the action is offered on. Default: open, held and accepted. A fixed finding shows only actions whose list has fixed. "fixed" alone is the older form of ["fixed"].

id.description: The key of this input in the request's inputs.

label.description: The field's name in the dialog, at most 80 characters.

required.description: True: the action can't run while it is empty. Default false.

max.description: text: at most 1,000 (default 200). textarea: at most 4,000 (default 2,000). Not for choice or bool.

choices.description: choice only: the choices, in order, each at most 100 characters.

default.description: bool: true or false. choice: one of the choices (default: the first). text and textarea: text no longer than max, without control characters (a textarea may hold line breaks and tabs).

then.$comment: A default longer than max (200 without one) is refused.
A default longer than max (2,000 without one) is refused.
default must be one of the choices.
